candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.0: Generation rate varies according to energy demand.
Generates Redstone Flux using fluid fuels and coolants.
Stronger coolants result in higher efficiency.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.enervation.0: Extracts Redstone Flux directly from natural sources or from objects which store it.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.magmatic.0: Generates Redstone Flux using extremely hot fluids.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.numismatic.0: Generates Redstone Flux using economic arbitrage.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.numismatic.1: Might be a portal to an alternate dimension of pure avarice.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.numismatic.2: Don't overthink it, just insert coins.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.reactant.0: Generates Redstone Flux using alchemical reactions.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.reactant.1: A solid reactant and a fluid fuel must be provided.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.dynamo.steam.1: Solid Fuels and Water can be used to generate Steam.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.brewer.1: You might want a few of these in a row.
Some items will result in a fluid component.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.charger.1: Charge rate may be limited by the item.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.compactor.0: Applies pressure to items, changing their form.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.crafter.0: Insert items into the grid to set a crafting recipe.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.crafter.1: Simply press the confirm button and walk away!
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.crucible.1: Very useful for building advanced blocks.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.crucible.2: Keep away from small children and pets.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.enchanter.1: Useful for acquiring a specific tome of enchantment.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.enchanter.2: Left slot can be locked to only contain specific items.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.extruder.0: Mixes water and lava to create various types of rock.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.extruder.1: The selected item is what you'll get, if there is enough water and lava in the tanks.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.furnace.1: Uses very little energy to cook food.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.insolator.0: Infuses nutrients and light into plants using Redstone Flux.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.insolator.2: Left slot can be locked to only contain specific items.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.precipitato: Uses Redstone Flux to freeze fluids!
The selected item is what you'll get, if there is enough of the correct fluid in the tank.
Useful for processing ores or converting items.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.refinery.1: Some fluids will leave behind a solid component.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.refinery.2: Products may or may not be drinkable.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.sawmill.0: Cuts logs into planks and reprocesses wooden things.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.sawmill.1: Very useful for making the most out of a tree.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.smelter.0: Smelts metals and things that require high temperatures.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.smelter.1: Useful for processing ores and building advanced blocks.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.machine.smelter.2: Left slot can be locked to only contain specific items.
Fills or empties things that hold fluids.
Click the button to change modes.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.cell.1: Hold Shift and/or Ctrl to fine tune energy control.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.enchant: Can be enchanted to increase storage capacity.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel.0: It's a satchel. It lets you carry more things.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel_c.0: It's a satchel, sort of. It creates copies of whatever you put inside.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel_c.2: It's "Creative" as in the mode. It's not meant to be all that clever.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel_fil: Configure which items this Satchel can automatically pick up.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel_v.0: It's a satchel, sort of. Anything you put in disappears forever.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.satchel_v.1: This includes items which are automatically picked up.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.strongbox.0: It's a box! It stores things. Well, most things.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.tank.0: It's a tank! It stores fluid.
candidate.tab.thermalexpansion.storage.tank.1: Can automatically output from the bottom side.
